why_this_file_exists: CC_0449 overwrites politician_images.url, politician_images.photo_license, politicians.photo_custom_url and politicians.photo_origin_url. None of these columns has a history table, so the previous values exist nowhere once it commits.

uploads.verified: Both new objects were fetched ANONYMOUSLY from the public CDN - no credentials, what a visitor's browser gets - and returned HTTP 200, image/jpeg, 600x750, byte-for-byte identical to what was uploaded. A correct API response is not evidence that an image landed.

before.what_it_was: an informal outdoor portrait, candidate-submitted to Ballotpedia, with no author and no terms published anywhere

after.crop: head-and-shoulders 4:5 window measured from the original: head top y=456, chin y=1205, face centre x=1368, giving crop box (869, 269, 1867, 1517) then resized to 600x750 with LANCZOS at quality 90. Measured, not eyeballed, and the full-length original would have center-cropped to a torso.
after.why_the_licence_improves: His campaign site's footer carries a press contact (press@ericjones.us) and publishes no copyright notice and no restriction. That is a licence read from the publisher, so press_use is supportable where it was not before. The route out of 'unknown' is a better SOURCE, not a better guess.

rows.change: the SAME photograph, re-mirrored at the house standard

after.note: licence and origin are unchanged - CC_0448 set them correctly and the photograph is the same one. Only the resolution moves. The old file also sat on the OTHER storage hostname; the new one uses the storage.supabase.co form, which is why the path check in the gate matches on the PATH and never on the host.

deliberately_not_changed.finding: She was going to be re-mirrored from the 2400x3000 navy.mil original. Rendering that original to 600x750 produced a file BYTE-IDENTICAL to the one already stored - sha256 f7de5334dc1149203174db03374ecd1b33a07807cb77a4164f088a57c8869ef8 for both. Her stored copy was already made from the federal original at full size; the Ballotpedia entry in her old origin was the route by which the photo was FOUND, not the pixels it came from.
deliberately_not_changed.lesson: A WORSE-LOOKING PROVENANCE DOES NOT IMPLY WORSE PIXELS. The identical byte count was what prompted the check; it was nearly read as a file mix-up and is in fact the deterministic result of the same resize of the same source.
deliberately_not_changed.action_taken: No database change. The redundant upload was deleted from storage so no orphan object is left behind, and CC_0449's gate asserts she is untouched.
